name: print-social-red-girls-night-flyer-with-cream-bubble-type-and-cutout
title: Party flyer in red with cream bubble letters, a white-outlined dancer cutout and DJ lineup
whatItIs: A textured red poster with a small tagline, giant cream chunky 'GIRLS NIGHT' with halftone shading, a cutout of a woman with sunglasses and braids outlined in thick cream overlapping the letters, then event name, date, venue and three DJ names in cream caps.
whatItMeans: Bold and joyful; retro bubble type and a cream outline feel like a party sticker.
techniques: Overlap the cutout on giant letters.
Outline the cutout in thick cream.
Use one red and one cream.
List details in a compact tri-row.

vocabulary.definition: A cutout figure breaking over text.
DJ names in a single line.
